description:
## Problem
Every shipped `*_tuned.yaml` looks equally trustworthy. Nothing tells a user that the Databricks, Snowflake and DuckDB templates have never been measured against `notuning`, or that the ClickHouse decisions hold only at SF1.

## Change
Implement owner decision D3 (label, do not quarantine; recorded in `tuning-evidence-tuned-mode-promise-20261008`):
- Add one registry file, `benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/template_evidence.yaml`, keyed platform → benchmark. Each entry has:
  - `state`: one of `unmeasured`, `measured-benefit`, `measured-neutral`, `measured-regression`;
  - `scale_factor`, `memory`, `engine_version`, `measured_on` (date) and `evidence` (ADR section or file path).
- Initial states:
  - ClickHouse `tpch`, `ssb` and `tpcds`: `unmeasured`. The 2026-10-07 numbers come from single sequential cells and are not harness-grade; the benefit rule's retroactive pass replaces them.
  - Every other template: `unmeasured`.
- The result records the state under `platform.tuning.template_evidence`.
- On a tuned run whose state is `unmeasured`, the console prints one line: "Tuned template <platform>/<benchmark> has no measured benefit: the result shows the template was applied, not that it is faster than notuning."
- The results Explorer shows the state as a row in `RunReceipt` ("Template evidence").

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Runs are never blocked because of the state; there is no hard gate.
- The state is metadata. It never enters `requested_config_hash`, and the hashes of existing templates stay the same.
- A shipped template must not be left at `measured-regression`.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
